meaning: very happy and proud of something
example: I passed my driving test, and now I feel on top of the world!
origin: Probably comes from the image of standing on the highest point of a mountain; the exact origin is not certain.

wrong_meanings.meaning: to be lost in a big city
wrong_meanings.why_wrong: This describes a problem with location, not a happy feeling.

wrong_meanings.meaning: to climb a very high mountain
wrong_meanings.why_wrong: This is the literal picture, not the idiomatic meaning.

wrong_meanings.meaning: to be very tired after work
wrong_meanings.why_wrong: The idiom describes a positive feeling, not being exhausted.

explanation: 'On top of the world' means feeling extremely happy or proud. It is a common idiom, so it is not meant to be understood literally.
